maria_cs: Quick heads-up — QBR dry run tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need final slide updates, spoken exec asks, and any onboarding risk callouts by EOD today.

 dan_prod: I can take slide 4 (product roadmap ask). I'll add 2 bullets and a backup slide.

 jordan_eng: can someone confirm the onboarding completion rate for Q1? I have old numbers.

 leila_csm: Current cohort completion is 78% (last updated yesterday). Main blockers: API key confusion and missing sample prompts.

 sam_ops: Renewal risk slide — need ARR by cohort and list of at-risk customers >30d without activation. I'll paste a short query in a sec.

 sam_ops: ```sql
SELECT account_id, ARR, last_active_at
FROM activations
WHERE days_since_activation > 30
ORDER BY ARR DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

 maria_cs: thanks @sam_ops — pls drop the top-10 table into slide 6 and mark 'follow-up owner' column. @dan_prod add the one-liner for mitigation.

 dan_prod: adding mitigation one-liner. Also, please check the canary fallback note on slide 8 — ops needs final approval.

 sam_ops: ops approves fallback copy. added :white_check_mark: 

 leila_csm: I'll own the exec ask for onboarding automation and present a 60s demo. Need the demo link from eng.

 jordan_eng: demo link: https://internal.redwood/demo/onboarding-automation — ping if access issues.

 remind-bot: Reminder set for 2025-06-05T17:00:00Z for channel customer-success — "QBR dry run prep: final assets due"

If anything slips, flag here with :warning:
